about: Independently worded fuzzy-clustering eval, written against the user-facing symptom rather than the embedder. Each group is one problem described four ways; hard_negatives are pairs that read alike but are different problems.

groups.label: clip-history-gone
texts: clipboard history is wiped when I log back in
every thing I copied is missing after the session ends
the copy list starts empty each time I reboot
clipboard keeps nothing across logout

groups.label: clip-paste-hang
texts: copying a screenshot locks the whole desktop up for a minute
pasting a big image makes the clipboard freeze
a large picture on the clipboard hangs the app
the desktop stalls whenever I paste something huge

groups.label: bar-battery-stale
texts: battery figure in the bar does not change after I wake the laptop
the percentage stays at the old value following suspend
after resume the bar still shows the level from before
power reading is stuck until I log out and back in

groups.label: net-wifi-wake
texts: wifi is gone after the lid opens and I have to reconnect
network drops every time the machine comes back from sleep
no internet after suspend until I toggle the adapter
wireless disconnects on resume

groups.label: bar-workspace-monitor
texts: workspace buttons disappear once a second display is attached
plugging in another monitor removes the workspace switcher from the bar
the workspaces widget is missing after I connect the external screen
adding a display makes the workspace list vanish

groups.label: search-index-slow
texts: indexing my documents takes hours
the search crawler is painfully slow on a big folder
building the search index over a large directory never finishes
documents take forever to be scanned for search

groups.label: lock-rejects-password
texts: the lock screen refuses my correct password
unlocking fails with wrong password even though it is right
login says the password is incorrect when it is not
I cannot get past the lock, it rejects what I typed

groups.label: paper-wallpaper-black
texts: background goes black when I switch the colour scheme
changing the palette makes the wallpaper disappear
the desktop picture turns black after a theme change
wallpaper is lost on palette switch

groups.label: pad-notes-lost
texts: scratchpad forgets what I typed when I shut the window
closing the notes window throws away the text
notes vanish if I close the pad without saving
everything written in the pad is gone after closing it

groups.label: video-stutter
texts: films play choppy with dropped frames
playback stutters constantly during movies
video is not smooth, it judders every few seconds
watching a show is unwatchable because of the frame drops

hard_negatives: bar shows the wrong battery percentage
bar shows the wrong clock time
notes are lost after closing the window
settings are lost after closing the window
search is slow indexing documents
search is slow when typing in the box
app crashes when I open settings
app crashes when I open the file manager
wallpaper turns black after theme change
window turns black after theme change
clipboard history is empty after restart
download history is empty after restart
video playback stutters in jellyfin
audio playback stutters in jellyfin
wifi disconnects after waking from sleep
bluetooth disconnects after waking from sleep
pasting a large image freezes the clipboard
pasting a large file freezes the file manager
lock screen rejects the correct password
login rejects the correct password for the git server
